blocks.id: blk:The rules this build holds to/1
blocks.text:
Evidence, not compliance. Nothing here says an organisation passes, fails,
   or is certified. It says what the published standard says, and where.

blocks.id: blk:The rules this build holds to/2
blocks.text:
Every claim names its source. A non-null canonical field carries at least one
   source reference; every reference resolves to an observation with a URL, a
   retrieval timestamp and a content hash. The gate fails otherwise.

blocks.id: blk:The rules this build holds to/3
blocks.text:
Conflicts are preserved, not resolved. Where the website and the official
   changelog repository disagree, both readings are kept and the difference is
   recorded. A difference that changes meaning is blocking; one that is only
   markdown escaping or bullet order is not, and says which it is.

blocks.text:

   sources; published crosswalks are AIUC's; a candidate this build noticed is graded
   proposed and marked needs_review on every surface it appears on. docs/meaning.md
   is the whole story.
